resources.string: Two things added to your TV: the spare remote button opens an app, and pressing Home twice opens a task switcher.\n\nNothing is sent anywhere. The app only reads the remote and keeps one picture per app on the TV.

Home twice → the app switcher.

OK opens the focused app.
Hold OK closes it.
The circle with “!” in the switcher brings this help back.

Accessibility (key filter) is how the spare button and the double Home are caught. Usage access is how the switcher knows which apps you used last.\n\nBoth are granted on the TV. Nothing leaves the device.
Your apps will appear here as you open them; each card shows the screen you left.\n\nSome apps (Netflix, Disney+, YouTube) do not allow being captured, so their card shows the app icon instead.
